The scene includes an oak plank U-shaped structure, oak log trees, a cobblestone pedestal with lantern, and ambient mobs (cow, sheep) as distractors. The coal block is clearly visible from spawn — elevated on its pedestal and contrasting against the green grass.

A lantern on cobblestone at (~-2, ~-4) adds visual interest. Cow and sheep provide ambient life. The /fill air command clears a 21x21x6 volume above the grass to ensure clear sightlines.
